cues: At a neighborhood block party, a bright brass tune gets dancers moving before the food is served.
In a school music lesson, beginners coordinate valve presses to play a simple melody together.
A piercing high note cuts through cafeteria chatter, drawing students' attention to the assembly stage.
At a birthday gathering, a few cheerful notes announce the cake as guests gather around the table.
At an outdoor singalong, a bright melody reinforces the chorus, helping participants keep their place in the song.
At a town fair, a jaunty brass melody invites passersby to pause near the bandstand.
